'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|New mission, soldier. I want whatever it is that comes in those crates. According to the intel, there's valuable military equipment inside. Oh and yeah, don't forget to take out the competition to make sure they don't steal anything important. By the way, I got a package I thought you might need. It's a gift from a mutual friend of ours. Don't look at me like that, I'm talking about the four-eyes.}}

==Objectives==
* Hand over 2 found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] [[Radar station spare parts]]
* Eliminate any 10 targets on any location with mortar strikes ([[Shoreline]], [[Woods]], [[Reserve]], [[Customs]])

==Rewards==
* +22,700 [[EXP]]
* 80,000 Roubles
** 84,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 92,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 2× [[Military power filter]]
{{quote|Good work! Now, what do we have here? Bingo, It's radar parts. It'll come in handy in the future. I think I know who might be interested. What? You wanna know too? It's not a soldier's job to ask questions. On your way, merc.}}
